print_orientation: vertical, dispense end (Z=0) on the build plate

pauses.name: ERM disc insertion
pauses.part: Adafruit #1201 vibrating motor disc (Ø10 × 2.7 mm, 3 V)
pauses.instructions: Pause printer at this Z. The +X radial pocket is now open; epoxy the ERM coin into the Ø10.3 × 2.9 mm pocket with leads exiting through the 1.5 × 2 mm wire channel toward the +X face. Resume to encapsulate the disc.

pauses.name: Solenoid insertion
pauses.part: Adafruit #412 JF-0530B 5 V mini push-pull solenoid (9.6 × 19 × 22 mm)
pauses.instructions: Pause printer at this Z. Insert the JF-0530B body into the -X pocket (plunger pointing toward the auger bore through the 2.5 × 6 mm slot). Route leads through the 2 × 2 mm wire channel. Resume to lock the solenoid in place.

install_after_print.name: Metal-gear servo install
install_after_print.instructions: Slide the servo into the +Y through-pocket and secure with two M3 screws through the chassis flange holes.

install_after_print.name: Pi Zero 2 W mount
install_after_print.part: Pi Zero 2 W on the -Y face landing
install_after_print.instructions: Bolt the Pi Zero 2 W onto the -Y bay using four M2.5 screws (58 × 23 mm pattern). Connect ERM/solenoid/servo leads through the wire channels and to the Bonnet.

install_after_print.name: Stepper + coupler install (top)
install_after_print.instructions: Slide the ST-FC01 coupler into the Ø19 × 26 mm chamber below the stepper plate. Drop the auger M3 spindle into one side of the coupler, the stepper's Ø5 D-cut shaft into the other. Bolt the stepper to the top plate (four M2.5 on a 23 × 23 mm pattern, Ø22 pilot pass-through).

notes: Pause Z is in millimetres along the chassis Z axis (matches the CadQuery script). Layer index = round(z_mm / layer_height_mm) at 0.2 mm; rescale if you slice differently.
